SNEHA KUMARI Business Analyst

Mobile: +91 9386661007

Email: tutusneha2@gmail.com

LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/in/snehakumari02

Profile Summary

Results-driven Business Analyst with 4 + years of experience across Trade Finance, Investment Management, and enterprise banking domains delivering API-driven digital transformation, system integration programmes, and data-led business solutions for global clients including Amazon, Microsoft, and Mars Inc. Experienced in end-to-end requirements elicitation, trade transaction workflow analysis, and functional documentation BRD, FRD, RTM across supply chain finance, treasury operations, pricing systems. Skilled in REST API integration specification, Agile delivery, and cross-functional stakeholder management, with strong technical proficiency in SQL, Power BI, and Postman,Python,Numpy,Pandas. Consistent track record of translating complex business requirements into scalable, enterprise-grade solutions with measurable impact. Actively leverages AI tools including Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and ChatGPT to accelerate documentation, analysis, and stakeholder communication workflows.

Core Competencies

Technical Skills











Business Documentation BRD, FRD, RTM, User Stories As-Is & To-Be Process Analysis, Gap Analysis & Scope Management Trade Finance & Banking Workflows- LC, Bank Guarantees, KYC/AML, Payment Lifecycle API Requirement Specification, System Integration & End-to-End Data Flow Analysis Stakeholder Management, Client Engagement & Agile Delivery UAT Coordination, Data Governance & Reconciliation

Requirements

Analysis &

Functional

Data Analysis & Querying: SQL (Joins, Aggregations, CTEs, Data Validation), Advanced Excel (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, Index-Match) Business Intelligence & Visualization: Microsoft Power BI, Alteryx Diagramming & Process Modeling: Lucidchart API & System Integration: REST API, JSON, Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI Project & Agile Management: Jira Documentation & Collaboration: Confluence AI Tools: Claude (Anthropic), Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT



Work Experience

Business Analyst | Yash Technology | Hyderabad

Client: Amazon, Microsoft, MARS

Jan 2025 – Present









Led requirements elicitation across Trade Finance and Supply Chain Finance programmes conducting stakeholder workshops to produce BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, and RTMs ensuring alignment between business expectations and technical delivery. Authored REST API integration specifications defining endpoint behaviour, JSON/XML payload structures, OAuth 2.0 authentication flows, error handling logic, and business validation rules serving as the primary integration reference for development and middleware teams. Executed As-Is & To-Be state analysis across trade transaction workflows identifying process bottlenecks and data inconsistencies across upstream/downstream systems translating findings into gap analysis reports that shaped solution design and sprint prioritization. Performed advanced SQL analysis on large transactional datasets to validate API data integrity and identify reconciliation discrepancies; designed ERDs and source-to-target data models in Lucidchart to support integration architecture decisions.

Defined and executed end-to-end UAT test scenarios covering functional flows, integration touchpoints, and edge conditions; validated REST API behaviour in Postman across authentication and exception scenarios achieving zero critical post-go-live defects across all deliveries.

Managed cross-functional stakeholder engagement across business, IT, compliance, and vendor teams for global clients including Amazon, Microsoft, and Mars Inc.; facilitated full Agile ceremony suite maintaining delivery velocity, scope control, and SLA compliance.

Business Analyst | Franklin Templeton Investments | Hyderabad

Client- HSBC, Axis Bank Jul 2022 – Jan 2025







Served as primary Business Analyst bridging treasury, pricing, and technology teams gathering and documenting business requirements, analyzing investment management workflows, and proposing process improvements to support portfolio management and trading operations Led Pricing Optimization (GPVS) initiatives by developing pricing models, performing segmentation analysis, and conducting SQL-based data analysis improving pricing model accuracy by 18% and portfolio valuation accuracy by 15% Conducted Treasury Operations Analysis (TMS-TACC) to strengthen internal controls, mitigate financial risks, and enhance reconciliation and reporting processes improving operational accuracy and auditability

Designed and implemented automated workflows for cash forecasting, investment analysis, and compliance monitoring reducing manual effort and



accelerating decision-making cycles Led functional requirements and integration validation for TMS connectivity with ERP platforms, banking portals, and trading systems ensuring data integrity across reconciliation and settlement workflows with ERP platforms, banking portals, and trading systems tracking issues, identifying root causes, and validating fixes through system testing

Projects

Project: Real-Time Pricing & Portfolio Valuation Dashboard | Franklin Templeton

Overview: Delivered a real-time market pricing and portfolio valuation platform consolidating multi-source data from Bloomberg and ICE to support Front Office investment decision-making across Equities, Derivatives, and Fixed Income asset classes benchmarking portfolio performance against market competitors including JPMC." Problem Statement: The existing pricing process relied on manual data collection from multiple market data sources (Bloomberg, ICE), causing delays in portfolio valuation, inefficient Front Office analyst workflows, and limited real-time market visibility across asset classes. Key Contributions:



Led end-to-end Business Analyst responsibilities for a real-time pricing dashboard from requirements gathering through UAT enabling portfolio valuation benchmarking against market peers including JPMC across equity and fixed income instruments.

• •

Gathered requirements from 15–20 pricing analysts, delivering BRD and data mapping documentation Consolidated historical market data from Bloomberg & ICE; performed SQL-based data validation and reconciliation Defined dashboard requirements and designed Power BI reports with 15-min auto-refresh, improving pricing accuracy by 18% and team efficiency by 60%



Followed Agile delivery across iterative cycles sprint planning, backlog grooming, and stakeholder walkthroughs with pricing, risk, and compliance teams

Tools: SQL | Power BI | Bloomberg Terminal| ICE Data Services| Advanced Excel | Confluence | Jira

Project: Supply Chain Finance & Trade Digitization Platform Client: Mars Inc. | Yash Technology

Overview: Mars Inc.'s global supplier payment lifecycle spanning PO management, shipment tracking, Letter of Credit issuance, and bank settlement was fragmented across enterprise ERP platforms, third-party logistics systems, and banking portals across 15+ countries, with no unified integration layer connecting supply chain operations to trade finance workflows. Problem Statement: No unified integration layer existed between Mars's supply chain and their trade finance workflows. LC issuance required manual bank communication, supplier KYC onboarding was entirely paper-based, and finance teams maintained parallel Excel trackers with zero real-time transaction visibility resulting in payment delays of 3-5 business days, high reconciliation error rates, and significant compliance risk. Key Contributions:



Executed As-Is & To-Be state analysis across the supplier lifecycle from PO creation through LC issuance, KYC validation, and payment settlement eliminating 14 manual intervention points via API-driven automation



Gathered end-to-end business requirements through stakeholder workshops with procurement, treasury, compliance, and banking teams delivering BRD, FRD, User Stories, and RTM covering 120+ functional requirements



Authored REST API integration specifications across enterprise ERP, logistics, and banking trade finance portal defining JSON payload structures, endpoint contracts, secure authentication flows, and error handling rules



Documented KYC/AML validation workflow requirements covering sanctions screening logic, risk-scoring rules, and compliance flag triggers ensuring regulatory alignment across 5 jurisdictions and reducing manual compliance effort by 70%



Defined and executed UAT test scenarios for LC issuance, payment events, KYC flows, and reconciliation edge cases validated 80+ API integrations in Postman, achieving zero critical defects at go-live.

Tools: SQL | Power BI | Postman | Jira | Confluence | Lucidchart | Advanced Excel | JSON/XML | REST API|Python

Certifications

Microsoft Power BI • • • •

Excel: Macro in Depth SQL Alteryx for Financial Services | Udemy Complete Project Manager's Practical Guide to Using AI 8 PDU |Udemy

Education





PGDM in Business Analytics & Finance Institute of Public Enterprise, Hyderabad, India | 2022 B.Com. (Honours in Accounts) Arvind Mahila College, Patna, India | 2019
